news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq drop as oil tops $95, bond yields rise
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks fell on Sept. 1 to open a seasonally weak month, with the S&P 500 down about 0.7%, the Nasdaq off more than 1% and the Dow down about 0.8%, as an oil spike and the highest Treasury yields since 2008 rattled investors.
news.conclusionZh: 美股9月1日下跌，标普500跌约0.7%，油价跳涨、美债收益率创2008年以来新高
news.whyEn: Rising yields lift borrowing costs on mortgages and corporate debt and pressure richly valued tech shares, while a fresh oil jump revives inflation fears just as the Fed weighs its first rate hike of the cycle.
news.whyZh: 收益率上升推高房贷和企业融资成本、打压高估值科技股，油价再度飙升重燃通胀担忧，正值美联储权衡本轮首次加息。
news.detailEn: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 4.79%, its highest intraday level since early 2025, and the 30-year yield held near 5.27%, close to multi-decade highs. Brent crude pushed above $95 a barrel after U.S. forces struck Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz and two tankers were hit leaving the waterway. Deutsche Bank told clients a September rate hike is now the most likely policy outcome. Traders are bracing for a heavy data week that includes ISM surveys, JOLTS openings and Friday's August jobs report, with chipmaker Broadcom reporting after Tuesday's close.
news.detailZh: 10年期美债收益率升至约4.79%，为2025年初以来盘中最高，30年期维持在5.27%附近，逼近数十年高位。在美军打击霍尔木兹海峡附近伊朗目标、两艘油轮驶离海峡时遇袭后，布伦特原油突破每桶95美元。德意志银行告诉客户，9月加息目前是「最可能的政策结果」。交易员正为数据密集的一周做准备，包括ISM调查、JOLTS职位空缺和周五的8月就业报告，芯片商博通将于周二收盘后发布财报。

news.titleEn: Hormuz Hostilities Pick Up as Two Tankers Reportedly Struck
news.conclusionEn: Two supertankers carrying Saudi crude were hit by projectiles in quick succession while exiting the Strait of Hormuz late Monday, and the U.S. military said it struck Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island that were preparing to mine the waterway, prompting Iran to fire missiles at U.S. bases in Jordan.
news.conclusionZh: 两艘满载沙特原油的油轮驶离霍尔木兹海峡时接连遇袭，美军空袭伊朗火箭发射器，伊朗向约旦美军基地还击
news.whyEn: The strait normally carries about a fifth of the world's seaborne oil, so renewed attacks after weeks of relative calm sharply raise the risk of a lasting supply shock and a wider U.S.-Iran conflict.
news.whyZh: 该海峡通常承运全球约五分之一的海运石油，相对平静数周后再遭袭击，大幅推高持久供应冲击与美伊冲突扩大的风险。
news.detailEn: Maritime security firms reported the tankers were damaged but not sunk, with crews accounted for, while shipping through Hormuz has already collapsed to roughly five commodity-vessel transits a day from a pre-war baseline near 85. President Trump said the strikes answered a failed attempt by Iran to lay mines and to hit a U.S. base, and warned Washington would hit Iran hard if attacks continued. Iran's Revolutionary Guard acknowledged casualties without giving numbers and vowed further retaliation. The exchange is the most serious escalation in the intermittent Hormuz conflict since U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran began earlier in 2026.
news.detailZh: 海事安全公司称油轮受损但未沉没，船员均安全；经霍尔木兹海峡的航运已从战前每天约85艘商品船骤降至约5艘。特朗普表示，空袭是回应伊朗布雷并袭击美军基地的失败企图，并警告若袭击持续，美方将狠狠打击伊朗。伊朗革命卫队承认有人员伤亡但未公布数字，并誓言进一步报复。此次交火是2026年初美以对伊朗动武以来，时断时续的霍尔木兹冲突中最严重的一次升级。

news.titleEn: Oil prices surge above $94 after U.S. strikes Iran in Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude climbed about 3.8% to $94.36 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate rose about 4.3% toward $90 on Sept. 1, the highest since late July, after U.S. forces struck Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 美军空袭后油价大涨，布伦特原油涨约3.8%至94.36美元，WTI涨约4.3%逼近90美元
news.whyEn: Sustained higher crude feeds directly into headline inflation and pump prices, squeezing consumers and transport-heavy industries and complicating rate decisions at the Fed and the ECB.
news.whyZh: 油价持续走高直接推升整体通胀和加油站价格，挤压消费者和运输密集型行业，也令美联储和欧洲央行的利率决策更棘手。
news.detailEn: U.S. gasoline had already averaged above $4 a gallon in August for the first time this cycle, and the fresh spike threatens to push it higher into the autumn. The International Energy Agency last month cut its 2026 global oil supply forecast to about 102 million barrels a day, down 4.3 million on the year, citing the collapse of a ceasefire and reduced Hormuz throughput. OPEC+ has completed the unwind of its 2023 voluntary cuts but plans to pause further increases in the fourth quarter. Analysts warn prices could stay elevated as long as tanker traffic through the strait remains disrupted.
news.detailZh: 美国8月汽油均价已首次突破每加仑4美元，此番新一轮上涨可能在秋季进一步推高油价。国际能源署上月将2026年全球石油供应预期下调至约每日1.02亿桶，同比减少430万桶，理由是停火破裂和霍尔木兹海峡通行量下降。OPEC+已完成对2023年自愿减产的退出，但计划在第四季度暂停进一步增产。分析人士警告，只要海峡油轮通行仍受扰乱，油价就可能维持高位。

news.titleEn: Eurozone inflation jumps to 3.3% in August as energy prices surge
news.conclusionEn: Euro-area annual inflation accelerated to 3.3% in August from 2.9% in July on a Eurostat flash estimate, driven by a 14.3% jump in energy prices, while core inflation eased slightly to 2.4%.
news.conclusionZh: 欧元区8月通胀率从7月的2.9%升至3.3%，主因能源价格同比涨14.3%，核心通胀微降至2.4%
news.whyEn: With headline inflation back above 3% and still rising, markets now see the European Central Bank almost certain to raise rates at its Sept. 10 meeting, a reversal after a long easing cycle.
news.whyZh: 整体通胀重回3%上方且仍在上升，市场现认为欧洲央行几乎肯定在9月10日会议上加息，扭转了长期宽松周期。
news.detailEn: Energy costs surged because of higher global oil and gas prices tied to the Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions. Among the largest economies, Spain recorded 4.5% inflation, Italy 3.2%, Germany 2.9% and France 2.7%, while services inflation moderated to 3.0%. Oxford Economics said the ECB is all but certain to hike next week. A move would align the ECB with a hawkish shift by the U.S. Federal Reserve and add to pressure on global bond markets, where yields are already at multi-year highs.
news.detailZh: 能源成本飙升源于伊朗冲突和霍尔木兹海峡航运受扰导致的全球油气价格上涨。主要经济体中，西班牙通胀率为4.5%、意大利3.2%、德国2.9%、法国2.7%，服务业通胀放缓至3.0%。牛津经济研究院称欧洲央行下周「几乎肯定加息」。此举将使欧洲央行与美联储的鹰派转向一致，并加大对全球债市的压力，目前债券收益率已处于多年高位。

news.titleEn: Bessent's Bond Gains Wiped Out as 30-Year Yields Jump Once Again
news.conclusionEn: The drop in long-term Treasury yields that followed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's decision to double long-dated bond buybacks has fully reversed, with the 30-year yield climbing back above 5.28% on Sept. 1 amid a global bond sell-off.
news.conclusionZh: 财长贝森特加倍长债回购一度压低的收益率已全部回吐，30年期美债收益率9月1日重回5.28%上方
news.whyEn: Rising long-term yields raise the cost of financing the federal deficit, mortgages and corporate borrowing, and signal that markets doubt the Treasury can tame the sell-off without help from the Fed.
news.whyZh: 长期收益率上升推高联邦赤字融资、房贷和企业借贷成本，也表明市场怀疑财政部在没有美联储配合下难以平息抛售。
news.detailEn: Starting Sept. 9, the Treasury will run buyback operations of at least $4 billion in the 10-to-30-year sectors, up from a $2 billion cap, and lift the number of long-end operations to four a quarter from two. Yields initially fell after the Aug. 19 announcement but reversed as an oil-driven inflation scare, a hawkish Fed and heavy global supply pushed government borrowing costs to their highest since 2008. Bessent has also floated tapping the near $1 trillion Treasury General Account to fund purchases. Analysts say the episode shows the limits of Treasury tools against a broad repricing of interest-rate risk.
news.detailZh: 从9月9日起，财政部将在10至30年期区间开展至少40亿美元的回购操作，高于此前20亿美元的上限，并将长端操作次数从每季两次增至四次。8月19日宣布后收益率一度下滑，但随后因油价推动的通胀恐慌、美联储偏鹰以及全球供给庞大，将政府借贷成本推至2008年以来最高而逆转。贝森特还提出动用近1万亿美元的财政部一般账户为购债提供资金。分析人士称，这一插曲显示出在利率风险被全面重新定价面前，财政部工具的局限。

news.titleEn: China's factory activity shrinks for second straight month, contracting less than expected
news.conclusionEn: China's official manufacturing PMI edged up to 49.8 in August from 49.2 in July, beating forecasts but staying below the 50 mark that separates growth from contraction for a second consecutive month.
news.conclusionZh: 中国8月官方制造业PMI从7月的49.2小幅回升至49.8，好于预期，但连续第二个月低于荣枯线50
news.whyEn: China is the world's second-largest economy and top commodity importer, so a still-shrinking factory sector weighs on global growth, exporters and demand for oil and metals.
news.whyZh: 中国是全球第二大经济体和最大商品进口国，制造业仍在收缩会拖累全球增长、出口商以及油价和金属需求。
news.detailEn: Output returned to expansion at 50.4 and new orders rose to 50.6, but factory employment stayed weak at 48.7 and firms kept cutting prices amid soft domestic and external demand and extreme summer weather. The private RatingDog survey, which tilts toward smaller exporters and was previously branded Caixin, had run just above 50 in July. Beijing has leaned on consumption subsidies, trade-in programs and services support rather than a large new stimulus package. Economists question whether momentum can hold into the fourth quarter, with U.S. tariffs and a weak property market still dragging.
news.detailZh: 产出回升至50.4的扩张区间，新订单升至50.6，但工厂就业维持在48.7的疲软水平，在内外需低迷和夏季极端天气下企业继续降价。偏向中小出口商、此前称为财新的RatingDog调查7月略高于50。北京主要依靠消费补贴、以旧换新和服务业支持，而非大规模新刺激。经济学家质疑这一势头能否延续到第四季度，美国关税和低迷的房地产市场仍在拖累。

news.titleEn: Manufacturing PMI at 54.6%; August 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI Report
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. ISM Manufacturing PMI slipped to 54.6% in August from 55.6% in July but marked an eighth straight month of expansion, with new orders at 53.7%, prices elevated at 71.1% and employment barely positive at 51.2%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国8月ISM制造业PMI从7月的55.6%回落至54.6%，仍连续第八个月扩张，但物价指数高达71.1%
news.whyEn: The survey shows U.S. factories still growing even as input prices stay high, reinforcing the case that inflation pressure is sticky and giving Fed hawks cover to raise rates in September.
news.whyZh: 调查显示美国工厂仍在增长，但投入价格居高不下，强化了通胀压力顽固的判断，为美联储鹰派9月加息提供依据。
news.detailEn: ISM said pricing volatility was cited in 57% of negative comments, alongside worries about tariffs, longer lead times and Middle East supply-chain risk, with one respondent likening conditions to the post-COVID disruption period. The overall economy has now expanded for 22 straight months by ISM's measure. The report is the first of several key data points this week, followed by JOLTS openings, ISM services and Friday's August jobs report. A firm manufacturing read alongside high prices adds to the argument that the Fed's next move is a hike rather than a hold.
news.detailZh: ISM称，57%的负面评论提到价格波动，同时担忧关税、交货周期延长和中东供应链风险，一位受访者将当前状况比作新冠疫情后的中断时期。按ISM口径，美国整体经济已连续22个月扩张。该报告是本周多项关键数据中的第一项，随后还有JOLTS职位空缺、ISM服务业指数和周五的8月就业报告。制造业数据稳健叠加高物价，进一步支持美联储下一步是加息而非按兵不动的观点。

news.titleEn: Broadcom Set to Report Q3 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
news.conclusionEn: Broadcom reports fiscal third-quarter results after the close on Sept. 2, with Wall Street expecting revenue near $29.4 billion, up more than 80% year over year, and AI-related semiconductor revenue of roughly $16 billion, more than triple a year earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 博通9月2日盘后发布财季业绩，市场预期营收约294亿美元、同比增超80%，AI芯片收入约160亿美元
news.whyEn: Broadcom is a bellwether for custom AI chip demand from cloud giants, so its results and order-backlog commentary can move the whole AI hardware complex at a moment when high valuations are already under pressure from rising yields.
news.whyZh: 博通是云计算巨头定制AI芯片需求的风向标，其业绩与订单指引会牵动整个AI硬件板块，而高估值正因收益率上升承压。
news.detailEn: Analysts expect semiconductor revenue around $20.5 billion, up roughly 124%, and infrastructure software near $8.9 billion. Management has guided to about $16 billion of AI chip revenue for the quarter, growth of more than 200%, and has pointed to more than $100 billion of AI chip revenue potential in fiscal 2027. The report lands in the same week as heavy U.S. economic data and alongside results from Dell. A strong number could steady richly valued chip stocks, while any hint of slowing orders would raise fresh doubts about the durability of the AI capital-spending boom.
news.detailZh: 分析师预计半导体收入约205亿美元、增长约124%，基础设施软件约89亿美元。管理层此前指引本季度AI芯片收入约160亿美元、增幅超200%，并称2027财年AI芯片收入潜力有望超过1000亿美元。这份财报与美国密集的经济数据在同一周公布，同期还有戴尔的业绩。强劲数据可能稳住估值高企的芯片股，而订单放缓的迹象则会重新引发对AI资本开支热潮持续性的质疑。

news.titleEn: Russian 'ballistic strike' on Kyiv rail depot kills at least seven, Ukraine rail chief says
news.conclusionEn: A Russian overnight ballistic missile attack on a railway depot and other rail facilities in Kyiv killed at least seven people, six of them railway workers, part of a broader barrage that left at least 12 dead across the capital region on Sept. 1.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军夜间弹道导弹袭击基辅一处铁路车辆段，至少7人死亡，其中6人为铁路工人
news.whyEn: The strike is the sixth straight night of large Russian attacks on Kyiv and underscores mounting damage to Ukraine's transport network, keeping pressure on Western governments over air defenses and sanctions.
news.whyZh: 这是俄军连续第六晚大规模袭击基辅，凸显乌克兰交通网络受损加剧，令西方在防空和制裁问题上持续承压。
news.detailEn: Ukraine's railway chief said a workshop near the depot was destroyed and one more employee was hospitalized, while dozens of workers who reached shelters survived. President Zelenskyy warned airlines and insurers that Russian airspace is becoming completely dangerous, pointing to Russia's expanding fleet of jet-powered attack drones. Kyiv has responded with long-range drone strikes on Russian refineries and military sites. There has been no meaningful movement toward a ceasefire, and both sides are preparing for another winter of fighting.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰铁路负责人称，车辆段附近一处车间被摧毁，另有一名员工住院，数十名及时进入掩体的工人幸免。泽连斯基警告航空公司和保险机构，俄罗斯领空「正变得极其危险」，并提到俄方不断扩大的喷气动力攻击无人机机队。基辅方面以对俄罗斯炼油厂和军事设施的远程无人机打击作为回应。目前停火没有实质进展，双方都在为又一个冬天的战斗做准备。

news.conclusionEn: Gold fell about 1.9% to around $4,359 an ounce on Sept. 1 as rising bets on a September Fed rate hike and higher Treasury yields pulled money out of the non-yielding metal.
news.conclusionZh: 金价9月1日下跌约1.9%至每盎司约4359美元，因加息预期升温、美债收益率走高
news.whyEn: Gold is a widely held inflation and crisis hedge, so a pullback despite Middle East conflict shows how strongly the prospect of higher real interest rates is now weighing on markets.
news.whyZh: 黄金是被广泛持有的通胀与避险资产，在中东冲突下仍回落，显示实际利率走高的前景正强烈压制市场。
news.detailEn: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole message that the central bank still has work to do on inflation has lifted rate-hike odds and Treasury yields, raising the opportunity cost of holding gold. The metal is still up sharply for 2026 after hitting a record above $5,600 an ounce in January during an earlier bout of geopolitical and dollar stress. Analysts say gold could rebound if Friday's jobs report is weak enough to cast doubt on a hike, or if the Hormuz conflict escalates further. For now, the stronger dollar and firmer yields are the dominant force.
news.detailZh: 美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔表示央行在通胀问题上仍「有工作要做」，推高了加息预期和美债收益率，加大了持有黄金的机会成本。在今年1月因地缘政治和美元压力一度触及每盎司5600美元上方的纪录后，金价2026年迄今仍大幅上涨。分析人士称，若周五就业报告疲软到令加息存疑，或霍尔木兹冲突进一步升级，金价可能反弹。目前美元走强和收益率走高是主导力量。

businessTips.explanationEn: The Theory of Constraints, developed by Eliyahu Goldratt, holds that every process has exactly one bottleneck that limits its total output at any given time. Improving a step that is not the bottleneck does not raise throughput and usually just piles up inventory or idle work. The practical method is to find the constraint, make sure it is never starved or blocked, subordinate everything else to keeping it fully fed, and only then spend money to expand it. Once that constraint is broken, a new one appears elsewhere and the cycle repeats.
businessTips.explanationZh: 制约理论由高德拉特提出，核心观点是：任何流程在特定时刻都恰好有一个瓶颈，决定了整体产出。改善非瓶颈环节并不能提高总吞吐量，往往只会堆积库存或半成品。实用方法是：找出制约因素，确保它既不缺料也不被堵住，让其他环节都服从于让瓶颈满负荷运转，然后才投入资源去扩容。一旦这个瓶颈被打破，新的瓶颈会在别处出现，循环往复。
businessTips.exampleEn: A small agency has four designers but only one senior reviewer who must sign off on every deliverable, so projects pile up waiting for review. Hiring a fifth designer would not help; instead the owner offloads the reviewer's admin tasks, adds a junior reviewer for simple jobs, and batches feedback twice a day. Turnaround time drops by a third even though total headcount barely changes.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家小型代理公司有四名设计师，却只有一名资深审核人，所有交付物都要他签字，于是项目全都卡在审核环节。再招第五名设计师无济于事；老板转而把审核人的行政杂务分出去，为简单任务增设一名初级审核人，并每天集中反馈两次。尽管总人数几乎没变，周转时间仍缩短了三分之一。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service takes work that is normally sold as custom, hourly consulting and repackages it as a fixed offer: one clear scope, one price, one turnaround time. This makes the service easy to buy without a long sales call, easy to deliver with checklists and templates, and easy to scale because every order looks the same. It also lets a solo operator raise effective hourly earnings by pricing on the value of the outcome rather than time spent. The trade-off is less flexibility, so the scope must be chosen carefully around a repeatable, high-demand problem.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「产品化服务」是把通常按小时、按定制方式出售的咨询工作，重新打包成一个固定方案：范围明确、价格固定、交付周期固定。这样客户无需漫长的销售沟通就能下单，服务方可以用清单和模板来交付，而且因为每个订单都长得一样，容易规模化。它还能让单打独斗的经营者按结果价值而非耗时来定价，从而提高有效时薪。代价是灵活性下降，因此范围必须围绕一个可重复、需求旺盛的问题来精心选择。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance developer who used to quote every website individually launches one package: a five-page marketing site on a fixed template, delivered in two weeks for a flat fee, with one round of revisions. Clients sign up from the web page without a meeting, and the developer reuses the same components each time, completing three builds a month at a higher margin than the old custom projects.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位过去为每个网站单独报价的自由开发者，推出了一个统一套餐：基于固定模板的五页营销网站，两周交付，一口价，含一轮修改。客户无需开会就能在网页上下单，开发者每次复用同一批组件，每月完成三个项目，利润率比过去的定制项目更高。

businessTips.explanationEn: The yield curve plots the interest rates on government bonds from short maturities to long ones. Normally it slopes upward because lenders demand more yield to tie up money for longer. When short-term yields rise above long-term yields the curve is inverted, which has historically preceded most U.S. recessions because it signals that markets expect the central bank to cut rates later as growth slows. The shape also affects bank profits, mortgage pricing and which bond maturities offer the best risk-adjusted return.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收益率曲线把政府债券从短期到长期的利率画成一条线。正常情况下它向上倾斜，因为出借人要求为长期锁定资金获得更高收益。当短期收益率高于长期收益率时，曲线「倒挂」，历史上这往往先于美国大多数衰退出现，因为它意味着市场预期央行未来会随增长放缓而降息。曲线形态还会影响银行利润、房贷定价，以及哪一段期限的债券风险调整后回报最好。
businessTips.exampleEn: In late 2026, with the Fed threatening to hike, two-year Treasury yields sit near 4.9% while thirty-year yields are above 5.2%, so the curve is steep, not inverted. An investor reads this as the market pricing in higher rates for longer rather than an imminent downturn, and chooses to hold more short-dated bonds to earn a solid yield with little price risk, planning to extend maturity only if the curve later flattens or inverts.
businessTips.exampleZh: 2026年底，美联储放话可能加息，两年期美债收益率约4.9%，而30年期高于5.2%，曲线是陡峭而非倒挂。投资者据此判断，市场定价的是「利率更高、持续更久」，而非即将到来的衰退，于是选择多持有短期债券，以较小的价格风险赚取可观收益，并计划只有当曲线日后走平或倒挂时才拉长久期。
